summary: Iteration 6 tested Financeiro (receipts, credits, PDF, WhatsApp send), the cron monthly-report endpoint and Geografia customers-by-region, all read-only against production. Backend: 20/20 pytest pass. GET /api/finance/customer/227427597/payments returns the 4 TESTR_ payments, login andrecartv, total_paid 44000; an unknown id returns an empty list; the endpoint needs auth. summary.credits = {used:17 (2x1m + 1x3m + 1x12m), per_plan default 1:1..12:12, unit_cost 0, cost 0, profit null}. report.pdf returns a %PDF with filename financeiro-2026-10.pdf, 400 for abc/2026-00/2026-13/1999-01 and 401 without a token. report/send returns {sent:false, reason:'WhatsApp do admin não configurado em Configurações'}. The cron endpoint returns 401 with no token, a wrong token or the admin JWT, and 200 {accepted:true} with WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET. geography/customers: totals match both the customer list and the region sums (13 active / 1 expired / 428 cancelled, 59 regions), and the endpoint needs auth. Frontend: credits-item-0..3 show 17 / — / — / 0,26 créd. plus the recharge hint. receipts-btn-TESTR_0 and customer-login-TESTR_1 both open receipts-dialog (4 items, 4 receipt-open links, Esc closes it). report-download-btn downloads a valid PDF. report-send-btn shows the toast 'Não enviado — WhatsApp do admin não configurado em Configurações'. Geografia region list, region selection, the Ativos/Vencidos/Cancelados tabs and region search all work. Settings shows both new fields, empty with placeholders; nothing was saved. No JS errors. The only non-GET calls were auth/login and report/send.

minor.issue: Cancelled customers are deduped only by id. The same person recreated with a new painel id (same login + phone, e.g. alissonnew 228105837/228408447, macedotv, reynaldo...) appears twice as cancelled. That is 17 duplicate logins and 57 duplicate phones in the current data, so the 428 cancelled count is inflated. A former id of a customer who is now active under a new id would also show as 'cancelled'. Dedupe by normalized login (and/or phone) against the current painel users.

Dedupe on X-Webhook-Id calls set_setting('cron_run_<id>'), which mirrors to Mongo Atlas (database.set_setting → mongo_store.upsert_setting). Every cron run adds a permanent settings key in both SQLite and Atlas, which bloats the table without bound. Consider a TTL'd/separate collection, or keep only the last N ids. The duplicate:true path was NOT exercised for that reason (it would write to production Atlas).

ui_bugs.issue: The placeholder says 'Buscar região ou cliente...', but filteredRegions filters only by region label/name. Typing a customer login (e.g. 'oscarnew', a cancelled customer in BR-67) hides every region (0 shown), so customer search never works. Fix: keep regions that contain a matching customer (or auto-select the region of the first match).

issues: Saldo no painel shows '0,26 créd.' while the balances API reports currency 'BRL'. If the balance is actually R$, both the 'créd.' label and the '49,74 gastos desde então' math (last_recharge_credits − balance) are wrong. Please verify the unit.
Unknown routes such as /geography render a completely blank page; add a catch-all 404 or a redirect.

action_items: Fix region-search so it also matches customers (login/name/phone) and keeps or selects their region
Dedupe geography cancelled customers by login/phone, not only by id
Avoid writing a permanent cron_run_<id> setting (mirrored to Atlas) on every cron call
Verify the painel balance unit (credits vs BRL) in the CreditsPanel
Remove the TESTR_ seeded payments before release
critical_code_review_comments: ReportActions download: URL.revokeObjectURL is called synchronously right after a.click(), and the <a> is never attached to the DOM, so the download can fail in Firefox/Safari. Append the anchor and revoke inside a setTimeout.
ReceiptsDialog has no error state; a failed request shows 'Nenhum pagamento deste cliente.'

finance._load_rows loads ALL payments plus the whole painel cache on every call (summary, PDF, receipts). build_pdf calls summary() and then paid_rows_for(), which loads everything twice. Acceptable at the current scale.

maybe_send_previous_month only sends on days 1-3 after 09:00 in the display tz. If the cron fires at 12:00 UTC (09:00 SP) it is right on the boundary. That works, but any tz drift would skip the month; the in-process hourly loop is the fallback.
The geography_customers SQLite rows always set is_trial False, so SQLite-only trial customers that left the painel would be counted as 'cancelled'.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_iter6_finance_geo.py. The geography route is /geografia (not /geography). Do not send cron requests with X-Webhook-Id: it writes to Atlas. The painel cache currently holds only 14 users, so most known customers show as cancelled.
rca of the issue: region-search: in RegionCustomers.jsx, filteredRegions = regions.filter(r => label/region includes q). The customer list filter also uses q, but it only runs for the selected region, and the region list is emptied first. Duplicate cancelled customers: in analytics.geography_customers, the `seen` set holds painel/Mongo ids; Mongo keeps old docs for re-created users under their old ids, so each old doc becomes an extra 'cancelled' entry.
